## Null design: importance of a forest when the response is independent of the features

Model: features: p-variate normal, unit variances, all correlations feature_correlation; y ~ N(0, 1) independent of the features; z ~ N(0, 1) independent of everything (an extra column, used by the variants padded_reduced and placebo_full only). Metric: mean squared error on the assessment rows; importance = MSE(Reduced) - MSE(Full), per split and anchor. 20 data sets per design, 5 folds, the same data, folds and seeds in every variant. `mean_importance` is the mean over data sets of the data-set mean (over anchors and splits); `mc_standard_error` is its Monte Carlo standard error (SD between data sets / sqrt(number of data sets)). `excess_mse_*` is the MSE of the model minus the MSE of predicting the training mean (positive: worse than no model).

## Variants

| variant | factor | change | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | - | - |  |
| mtry_as_full | candidates per split | {'mtry': 'as_full'} | both models draw floor(sqrt(p)) candidates, the number of the Full model |
| mtry_all | candidates per split | {'mtry': 'all'} | every column is a candidate at every split (bagging) |
| mtry_one | candidates per split | {'mtry': 'one'} | one candidate per split |
| depth2 | tree depth | {'max_depth': 2} |  |
| large_nodes | tree depth | {'r': {'min.node.size': 50, 'min.bucket': 1}, 'python': {'min_samples_split': 2, 'min_samples_leaf': 50}} | each language's own node-size parameter raised from 5 to 50 |
| no_bootstrap | bootstrap sampling | {'bootstrap': False} | every tree sees every training row once; trees differ by the candidate draws only |
| trees50 | learner variance (number of trees) | {'trees': 50} |  |
| trees2000 | learner variance (number of trees) | {'trees': 2000} |  |
| padded_reduced | number of columns | {'representation': 'padded_reduced'} | the Reduced model also gets the independent noise column z: both models have p columns |
| placebo_full | number of columns | {'representation': 'placebo_full'} | the Full model is the Reduced representation plus the noise column z (the anchor itself is not used): the 'importance' of pure noise |
| split6 | node-size rule (Python only) | {'python': {'min_samples_split': 6, 'min_samples_leaf': 1}} | the scikit-learn setting closest to the R built-in (docs/random_forest_comparison.md) |
| ols | learner | {'learner': 'ols'} | ordinary least squares: the Full model estimates one coefficient more |

Baseline: the forests of experiment B6: R = settings of the built-in "rand_forest" learner (ranger called directly), Python = python/sharedimp_exp/learners.py; settings {'learner': 'forest', 'trees': 500, 'mtry': 'sqrt', 'max_depth': None, 'bootstrap': True, 'representation': 'standard', 'r': {'min.node.size': 5, 'min.bucket': 1}, 'python': {'min_samples_split': 2, 'min_samples_leaf': 5}}.
